div.head: CHn cor 3.2
div.ab: Et si, mortuo barone uel alio homine meo, filia heres remanserit, illam dabo consilio baronum meorum cum terra sua.
Et si, mortuo barone vel alio homine meo, filia heres remanserit, illam dabo consilio baronum meorum cum terra sua.
And if, on the death of a baron or any other vassal of mine, his daughter is left as heiress, I shall bestow her in marriage, with the consent of my barons, along with her land.

note.quote: both texts were concerned with the position of widows
